europe_now.title: Poland Detains Suspect Over Alleged Plot Targeting PM Tusk
europe_now.summary: Authorities in Poland have detained a man who was suspected of planning an assassination attempt against Prime Minister Donald Tusk. The security incident highlights ongoing domestic political tensions and threats within the country.

europe_now.title: Trump Announces Energy Ceasefire Between Russia and Ukraine
europe_now.summary: Former US President Donald Trump stated that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy infrastructure ceasefire during ongoing conflict negotiations. Ukrainian leadership responded by noting that the announcement came as an unexpected development.

top_stories.title: French Left-Wing Primary Outcome
top_stories.summary: Raphaël Glucksmann emerged victorious in the French center-left primary election, securing 66 percent of the vote. He will now represent his political movement as a candidate in the upcoming presidential race.

top_stories.title: Kraków Mayoral Election Results
top_stories.summary: An independent candidate defeated the political contender backed by Prime Minister Donald Tusk in the Kraków mayoral runoff election. This municipal outcome represents a notable political setback for the governing leadership.
